# Torah Lock

> Torah Lock is an iOS app that blocks distracting apps each morning until you complete a short Jewish prayer — the Shema and personalized Tehillim (Psalms). It helps Jews put Hashem first before the day's noise begins. App restrictions run entirely on-device via Apple's Screen Time / Family Controls framework; Torah Lock does not collect or transmit which apps you use.

Key facts:
- Platform: iOS (iPhone). Free to download, with optional subscription.
- Daily enforcement window: 5:30 AM until the morning prayer is completed (under 5 minutes).
- Shabbat-aware: automatically detects Shabbat and Jewish holidays by location (via Hebcal) and does not block on holy days; streaks are preserved.
- Privacy: on-device enforcement; no app-usage data collected. Analytics via PostHog (anonymous), subscriptions via RevenueCat.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6759348814
